description: Create and update interviews and rounds, notes, transcripts, briefings, recordings, scorecards, debriefs, invites, checks, thank-you notes and next-steps or feedback notes to employers. Actions: create, update, add_round, update_round, add_correspondence, add_transcript, link_calendar, generate_briefing, attach_recording, detach_recording, score_round, add_interviewer, save_debrief, mark_invite_seen, rate_tracking, answer_check, mark_thank_you_done, draft_thank_you, draft_follow_up. Call with action "help" for each action's fields.

check_id.description: An interview check-in's id from get_interviews follow_ups (checks[].id).

event_id.description: An interview round's id from get_interviews get.

follow_up_key.description: A thank-you follow-up's key from get_interviews follow_ups (followUps[].key).

interview_id.description: An interview's id from get_interviews list, or a follow_ups item's processId.

invite_id.description: An interview invite's id from get_interviews follow_ups (invites[].id).

params.description: Fields for the action. Call with action "help" to list each action's fields.

name: manage_interviews
title: Manage interviews
